description: This file defines the ACLJSController class responsible for generating JavaScript code to enforce access control list (ACL) permissions in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for constructing JavaScript snippets that disable or modify form elements based on user permissions, and handles dynamic inclusion of ACL definitions.

classes.name: ACLJSController
classes.description: Controller class for generating ACL-related JavaScript code and handling ACL form element modifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing module, form, and ownership status.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to enforce ACL permissions on the client side based on current user access rights.

methods.name: getHTMLValues
methods.description: Returns HTML attribute values for form elements based on display options.

methods.name: getFieldByIdScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to disable or modify a form element identified by ID if access is denied.

methods.name: getFieldByNameScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to disable or modify form elements identified by name if access is denied.

methods.name: getFieldByFormScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to modify form elements within a specific form if access is denied.
